faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GMC Jalna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GMC Jalna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GMC Jalna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Government Medical College, Jalna, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Postgraduate degree MD/MS/DNB in the concerned subject (as per notifications 14.02.2022 and 30.06.2025), 1 year Senior Resident experience in a recognized medical institution, and the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and the Basic Course in Medical Education Technology completed or to be undergone.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
Q6. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract basis for 364 days, temporary in nature. Filled through the Local Selection Committee process.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
Q8. What is the advertisement number of this recruitment?
faq.answer: It is Advt No. शावैमजा/आस्था-राजप १ व २/जाहिरात-२६/3042/२०२६.
